description: Tool browser-first per gestire prodotti, calcolare margini netti e percentuali in tempo reale, importare dati da template CSV ed esportare i dati visibili.

userStories.title: Scaffold SvelteKit app with Tailwind
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a SvelteKit and Svelte 5 project configured with Tailwind so the margin tool has the required frontend foundation.
acceptanceCriteria: Create the app using SvelteKit with Svelte 5 conventions and typescript
Configure Tailwind CSS for application styling
Enable SvelteKit remote functions in svelte.config.js with kit.experimental.remoteFunctions and compilerOptions.experimental.async
The default route renders successfully
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add Prisma with SQLite schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need Prisma and SQLite models for products and settings so product data and payout percentage are persisted.
acceptanceCriteria: Configure Prisma to use SQLite
Add Product model with code, description, category, listPrice, supplierPrice, vatRate, discountPercent, createdAt, and updatedAt fields
Add Settings model with payoutPercent, createdAt, and updatedAt fields
Add the SQLite database file path to .gitignore while keeping Prisma schema and migrations tracked
Generate and run the initial migration successfully
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create product and settings data access
userStories.description: As a developer, I need server-side data access for products and settings so the UI can load and persist application data.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement data access in one or more .remote.ts files using SvelteKit remote functions from $app/server
Use a remote query to load all products ordered by category and code
Use a remote query to load settings with payoutPercent defaulting to 0 when no settings row exists
Use remote form or command functions, not SvelteKit endpoints or classic form actions, to create, update, and delete products
Use a remote form or command function, not a SvelteKit endpoint or classic form action, to update payoutPercent
Validate remote function inputs with a standard schema library before writing to Prisma
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement margin calculation utility
userStories.description: As a user, I want margins calculated consistently so I can trust the values shown in the product table and CSV export.
acceptanceCriteria: Calculate discountedGrossPrice as listPrice multiplied by 1 minus discountPercent divided by 100
Calculate netRevenue as discountedGrossPrice divided by 1 plus vatRate divided by 100
Calculate payoutAmount as discountedGrossPrice multiplied by payoutPercent divided by 100
Calculate marginAmount as netRevenue minus supplierPrice minus payoutAmount
Calculate marginPercent as marginAmount divided by netRevenue multiplied by 100
Handle zero or invalid netRevenue without crashing
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build editable products table
userStories.description: As a user, I want to view and edit product data in a compact table so I can quickly compare product margins.
acceptanceCriteria: Main page shows product rows with code, description, category, listPrice, supplierPrice, vatRate, discountPercent, marginAmount, and marginPercent
The product table includes an action to add a new product at any time
Discount percent defaults to 0 for new products
Changing editable product fields updates the displayed margin reactively using Svelte 5 state and derived values
Rows can be saved after editing through SvelteKit remote form or command functions
Each existing product row can be removed with a confirmation step through a SvelteKit remote form or command function
Margin values are visually distinguished for negative, low, and healthy margins
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using Codex browser or in-app browser

userStories.title: Build payout settings page
userStories.description: As a user, I want to save the payout percentage for incaricate alla vendita so all product margins include that cost.
acceptanceCriteria: Add an Impostazioni page or section for payoutPercent
Saving payoutPercent uses a SvelteKit remote form or command function and persists it to SQLite through Prisma
Changing payoutPercent updates product margin calculations after reload
The payout input accepts percentage values and prevents invalid negative values
